outcome: transfusion requirement of packed red cells
cohort: 124 pregnant women with at least 1 prior cesarean section and diagnosed with anterior placenta previa and accreta between January 2014 and October 2017
finding: The study found that PTUI was associated with reduced intraoperative blood loss, related vaginal blood loss after surgery, transfusion requirement, cesarean hysterectomy, and intensive care unit admission compared to ordinary cesarean section in patients with prior cesarean section and anterior placenta previa and accreta.
mod_finding: PTUI was associated with remarkably reduced intraoperative blood loss, related vaginal blood loss after surgery, and transfusion requirement of packed red cells, compared to the ordinary cesarean section.
